fields.admin_requirements: Suite administrators can disable the feature globally. Satellite nodes accept requests by default; other node roles must set ARTHEXIS_REMOTE_UPGRADE_REQUESTS=1, and any node can set ARTHEXIS_REMOTE_UPGRADE_REQUESTS=0 to reject locally.
fields.public_requirements: No public surface; requests travel through signed node transport.
fields.service_requirements: When the suite feature is disabled, nodes reject incoming remote upgrade requests without triggering upgrade checks. When enabled, Satellite nodes accept by default and other roles require local env opt-in.
fields.summary: Allows Satellite and opted-in downstream nodes to accept signed upstream requests to run their local upgrade check.
